name: Velozity
summary: Multiplayer AI office for remote teams: work with people and AI agents in one place for calls, tasks, notes and agents. Free to start.
description: Multiplayer AI office for remote teams: work with people and AI agents in one place for calls, tasks, notes and agents. Free to start.

pricing.details: Office Space Free forever — up to 3 people per cabin, 1 meeting room, up to 2 guest passes, 30 days of chat history, transcripts 7 days, 300 minutes of call transcription/month shared, 1 app integration. Office Space Pro 6 €/user/month — unlimited people per cabin and meeting rooms, up to 25 guest passes, unlimited chat history and transcripts, unlimited transcription (fair use). AI Space Free — 15 personal Tasks a week / 60 a month, 200 minutes of meeting transcription, 30 minutes a month of your own agents. AI Space Pro 7 €/user/month — unlimited personal Tasks, 1,000 minutes of meeting transcription, run your own agents with no time limit. Co-Worker Free — 300 credits/month. Co-Worker Pro 14 €/user/month — 1,100 credits/month, 15 automatic missions/month.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Multiplayer AI office with three official surfaces: Office Space, AI Space and Co-Worker
Calls, tasks, notes and agents in one place for remote teams
Free to start on every surface; Pro seats are assigned per surface
